title: Digital arrest (Hindi): payee's number rated high fraud risk
story: A 'TRAI officer' says illegal messages were sent from his number, then 'Mumbai Police' on a video call demands ₹60,000 as 'bail security'. He uses the app in Hindi.
why: ₹60,000 (45× usual) to a first-time payee whose linked number DoT rates high fraud risk, during a 75-minute internet call from an unknown number. Hindi screen should carry the same warning.
